annotations.title: Honeypot and rug-pull check for an ERC-20 before swap or approve

description:
Honeypot and rug-pull check for an ERC-20 on Base or Ethereum before a swap, approval or signature, read straight from the contract: upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967, beacon, clone), owner powers in the bytecode (mint, pause, blacklist, fee or max-tx setters, trading switch, burn from any address), owner renounced or active and the owner's share of supply; known issuers labeled. Risk low, medium or high with reasons. Signals, not investment advice. Free with a key (500 calls) or 5 calls a day without one; then 0.02 USDC per call via x402, or 1 call from a key.
After: preflight before your agent pays or signs on the site that offers this token (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Your key instead of paying per call: free (500 calls, POST /key) or bought by card. The connection header X-Bundle-Token works too.

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from (optional; the x402 price is the same for every address).

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.
